name: What does insurance coordinated interior restoration involve?

mainEntity.name: What does insurance coordinated interior restoration involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance coordinated interior restoration is the process of rebuilding and repairing damaged living areas following an insured event like pipe bursts, plumbing leaks, or storm damage. Rather than having you juggle multiple independent trade contractors, HH Remodeling acts as a single point of contact. We review the adjuster's line-item estimate, verify that all necessary structural and cosmetic repairs are accounted for, and rebuild framing, drywall, custom tile, trim, and paint to return your home to pre-loss condition or better. This coordinated approach ensures rebuild scopes align directly with insurance paperwork.
acceptedAnswer.description: It involves repairing damaged home interiors by matching scopes of work directly to insurance claim line items, managing trades from framing and drywall to finish carpentry and paint.
